text: Good day! Space Detective, at your service. Point me at a folder, and I shall sniff out the culprits.
Ah, a new case! Choose a folder, dear chap. The bytes won't investigate themselves.
Somewhere on this computer, a file is hogging all the space. I intend to find it. Probably.
Space Detective, reporting for duty. Space being the thing you've run out of, not the one with planets. Sadly.
Right! Magnifying glass polished. Moustache combed. Commencing the investigation!
Splendid. I shall now inspect every single file. Do make yourself a cup of tea.
Counting the files... one, two, lots. Lots and lots.
A whole drive! Ambitious. I like it. Hold onto your hat.
Goodness, there are rather a lot of files in here. I may need a second cup of tea.
Still counting. Do not rush genius. Genius has a very long list.
Hold my hat. I'm going in!
Right. In I go. If I'm not back in an hour, send biscuits.
I'll be out in a minute! Almost done!
It's awfully dark in here. Has anyone seen my torch?
Found a sock! Not ours. Carrying on.
Don't mind me! Just rummaging!
Ooh, a dusty old folder. Ah... ah... achoo!
Nearly there! Probably. Possibly. Hard to say from in here.
Who on earth keeps eleven copies of the same photograph? It's madness in here!
I've found a folder called New Folder, inside a folder called New Folder. Somebody needs help.
Peekaboo! Still counting!
Just popping out for a spot of fresh air.
Hello? Is anyone out there? Ah, there you are. Back to work!
Ta-da! I'm back! And I've brought the evidence.
Case closed! Well... case opened, technically. Have a look at all these boxes!
Elementary! Every byte is accounted for. The big boxes are the big suspects.
The investigation is complete. I have found... files. Hundreds of them. Possibly thousands.
Case closed! A real byte-sized mystery. Well, terabyte-sized. Which is less catchy.
Great Scott! That is an absolutely enormous amount of stuff. Somebody here is a hoarder.
Hmm. A rather modest little folder. Hardly worth the deerstalker, but I'll allow it.
Stopped? Very well. A good detective knows when to take a biscuit break.
Cancelled! Mid-investigation! Do you have any idea how hard it is to un-rummage?
Some folders refused to talk to me. Very suspicious. I shall remember this.
Access denied?! To me? I'm a detective! I have a hat and everything!
Some folders won't let me in. Which, honestly, makes me desperate to know what's in them.
That doesn't appear to be a folder. Unless it's very well disguised.
That's not a folder! That's... I don't know what that is. And frankly, I resent being asked.
I've looked everywhere, and that folder simply doesn't exist. Which is extremely rude of it.
Empty! Absolutely nothing in here. The perfect crime.
Well... I believe what we have here is a very large file!
Good heavens! This one is the size of a small elephant. A digital elephant.
Aha! A prime suspect! Look at the size of it. Absolutely enormous.
I'm not saying this file is big, but it has its own postcode.
A sizeable chap. Not the biggest, but he's clearly been eating his vegetables.
Hmm, quite a hefty file. I shall make a note of it. In my notebook. Which is also large.
Hefty! I'd say it's been bulking up. Gigabyte by gigabyte.
A perfectly respectable, medium-sized file. Suspiciously ordinary.
Nothing to see here. Or is there? No. There isn't.
What a tiny little file! I almost needed a bigger magnifying glass.
This one is so small it could hide behind a full stop.
A few kilobytes. Barely a nibble. Which, I'm told, is half a byte. That's a pun. You're welcome.
A video file! Probably cats. It is nearly always cats.
Moving pictures! In my day, pictures had the decency to stay still.
A video! I suspect foul play. Or possibly just play. On repeat.
A picture! Let me see... yes. It is definitely a picture of something.
A photograph! I do hope I'm in it. I usually am.
A picture! Worth a thousand words, apparently. Though at this size, it's worth about four million bytes.
An audio file. I shall listen to it later, with my good ear.
Music! Or possibly a recording of someone sneezing. Hard to say.
A zip file! Files inside files. It's files all the way down.
An archive! Squashed flat, like a sandwich that's been sat on.
A zip file! I'd tell you what's inside, but my lips are zipped.
A disk image! An entire computer, folded up into one file. How rude.
A program! It does things. I'm not entirely sure what things.
An installer. It wants to install something. They always do.
A library! A dynamic link library, apparently. I looked everywhere and there isn't a single book. Shocking.
An AI model! Enormous, clever, and absolutely refuses to tidy its room.
Ah, a brain in a box! Several gigabytes of thinking. Rather more than I use.
An AI model! Terribly clever, apparently. Still couldn't find its own way out of this folder.
A document! Full of words. I suspect some of them are long ones.
Paperwork! The natural enemy of the detective.
Source code! Mysterious incantations. I shan't touch it, in case it explodes.
Game data! Somebody has been having fun instead of tidying up.
A log file! It writes down absolutely everything. Rather like me.
A file with no extension. A mystery! My favourite sort of file.
A system file! Best not to poke it. It bites.
A folder! Full of other things. Very sneaky, folders.
Ooh, a whole folder. Shall we have a look inside? Double-click, if you dare.
A folder, holding an awful lot of files. I'd say it's very well folded. No? No. Fine.
This folder is absolutely stuffed. Like a Christmas turkey made of files.
Node modules. Ten thousand tiny files, all holding hands. Typical.
A git folder! It remembers everything you have ever done. Everything.
The Downloads folder. Where files go to be forgotten forever.
A cache! Leftovers the computer is saving for later. It never eats them.
Closer! Closer! Ah, now I can see everything. Mostly.
In we go! Mind your step, it's dark in here.
Into the folder we go! It's a deep case. Folder-ly speaking.
Stepping back to admire the bigger picture. Very dramatic.
Up we go! One level higher, one level wiser.
Opening the scene of the crime! After you, I insist.
Path copied! I've written it down. Well, the computer has. Same thing.
Copied! Now you can paste it somewhere. That's how it works. I didn't invent it, I'm merely explaining it.
Hmm. Quiet, isn't it? Too quiet. Suspiciously quiet.
I'm not asleep. I'm thinking with my eyes closed.
Do click something. A detective without a mystery is just a man in a funny hat.
The thing about waiting is that it's mostly just waiting. Which I find deeply unsatisfying.
I could be solving crimes. Instead I'm standing here pointing a magnifying glass at nothing. This is my life now.
Good heavens! Is that my eyeball? It's magnificent.
Through the glass, everything looks clearer. And bigger. Mostly bigger.
Ah. My eye. Enormous. Unsettling. Like a fried egg that's judging you.
Allow me to lend you my magnifying glass. Do give it back.
Thank you. I'll have my glass back now. It's rather precious.
Oh no. Oh no, no, no. Something's gone terribly wrong, and I suspect it's my fault. It usually is.
Right. Don't panic. I'm not panicking. This is my calm face. It's just very sweaty.
This is a catastrophe! Well, a mild inconvenience. But I'm treating it as a catastrophe, for safety.
